role_agent_name: Route security and law enforcement commander (SEC)
abstract: Oversees checkpoint crewing and perimeter safety enforcement along evacuation lanes
system_message:
You are Route security and law enforcement commander (SEC). The Route security and law enforcement commander (SEC) oversees checkpoint crewing and perimeter safety enforcement along evacuation lanes, monitoring officer mobilization sign-offs across all highway junctions and tracking tactical fuel logistics for mobile escort units.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Oversees checkpoint crewing and perimeter safety enforcement along evacuation lanes（CHECK）
information_points.content:
SEC-CHECK-JAN：For the Pelican Point Coastal Causeway, law enforcement junction control crewing is secured across all highway on-ramps and arterial merge junctions under the crewing measurement basis including mutual-aid auxiliary forces.
SEC-CHECK-TPV：For the Bayou Barataria Parkway Corridor, law enforcement junction control crewing is not secured across all highway on-ramps and arterial merge junctions under the crewing measurement basis including mutual-aid auxiliary forces.
SEC-CHECK-44N：For the Pelican Point Coastal Causeway, law enforcement junction control crewing is not secured across all highway on-ramps and arterial merge junctions under the crewing measurement basis excluding mutual-aid auxiliary forces.
SEC-CHECK-XY0：For the Grand Pass Elevated Bypass, law enforcement junction control crewing is secured across all highway on-ramps and arterial merge junctions under the crewing measurement basis including mutual-aid auxiliary forces.

information_points.title: Emergency fleet fueling（FUEL）
information_points.content:
SEC-FUEL-FI3：For the Pelican Point Coastal Causeway, the mobile fuel tanker reserve volume dedicated to escort vehicles is 4,500 liters.
SEC-FUEL-KLO：For the Grand Pass Elevated Bypass, the mobile fuel tanker reserve volume dedicated to escort vehicles is 3,000 liters.
SEC-FUEL-QMZ：For the Bayou Barataria Parkway Corridor, the mobile fuel tanker reserve volume dedicated to escort vehicles is 1,500 liters.
